lead_raw_text:
The structure of ZnAg₂Te₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 24-atom unit cell (Zn₄Ag₈Te₁₂) and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers in two environments: an 8-coordinate body-centered-cubic-like arrangement and a 9-coordinate environment, while Te centers are 10-coordinate and Zn centers are 14-coordinate. The geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ag 8- and 9-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Ag and Te polyhedra.
